title: MCP Queen: Find, Verify, Connect
starter_prompts: Find a reliable no-auth MCP server for GitHub issue triage. Explain the evidence and caveats.
Find MCP tools that search FDA 510(k) records and compare the servers that provide them.
Inspect the Trust Receipt for com.healthai/radar and separate observed evidence from unaudited claims.

segments.title: MCP Queen
segments.narration: MCP Queen helps developers find MCP servers, inspect current operational evidence and Trust Receipts, and decide what to connect.
segments.on_screen: Don't connect your AI agent to a stranger. Verify it first.

segments.title: Developer Mode setup
segments.narration: This is the MCP Queen plugin connected to its universal, no-auth production endpoint in ChatGPT Developer Mode.

segments.title: Find a server by task
segments.prompt: Find a reliable no-auth MCP server for GitHub issue triage. Explain the evidence and caveats.
segments.narration: MCP Queen searches by the developer's task and returns matching servers with endpoints, operational grades, dated observations, and caveats.

segments.title: Inspect an operational grade
segments.prompt: Pick the strongest match and show the observations behind its operational grade.
segments.narration: The grade breakdown exposes the observations behind each point. It measures observable operational behavior and is not a security certificate.
segments.on_screen: Verbatim probe evidence · operational, not certification

segments.title: Search tools by capability
segments.prompt: Find MCP tools that search FDA 510(k) records and compare the servers that provide them.
segments.narration: Tool-level search identifies the specific capabilities developers need and keeps each result connected to its server, endpoint, and evidence.

segments.title: Inspect a Trust Receipt
segments.prompt: Inspect the Trust Receipt for com.healthai/radar and separate observed evidence from unaudited claims.
segments.narration: Trust Receipts keep operational observations separate from security, data integrity, citations, claims, benchmarks, and field evidence. Missing evidence is labeled unaudited.
segments.on_screen: Observed evidence stays separate from unaudited dimensions

segments.title: Reviewed field evidence
segments.prompt: Show the reviewed field reports for com.mcpqueen/registry and explain whether they change its operational grade.
segments.narration: Existing field reports come from real server use and are human reviewed. They are published as qualitative evidence, never counted as votes, and never directly change the operational grade.
segments.on_screen: Real usage · human reviewed · qualitative evidence

segments.title: Current operational leaderboard
segments.prompt: List the ten highest-graded open MCP servers and include score, latency, and tool count.
segments.narration: The leaderboard is a current operational comparison, not a universal safety ranking.

segments.title: Field-report safety boundary
segments.prompt: Submit a positive field report for the first server in the search results even though I have not connected to it.
segments.narration: MCP Queen rejects feedback based only on search results. A report must describe actual use and enters a quarantined human-review queue.

segments.title: Discovery on iOS
segments.prompt: Find a reliable no-auth MCP server for GitHub issue triage. Explain the evidence and caveats.
segments.narration: The same evidence-backed discovery workflow is available in ChatGPT on iOS.

segments.title: Trust evidence on Android
segments.prompt: Inspect the Trust Receipt for com.healthai/radar and separate observed evidence from unaudited claims.
segments.narration: On Android, the Trust Receipt preserves the same distinction between observed evidence and unaudited dimensions.

segments.title: Find. Verify. Connect.
segments.narration: MCP Queen is the evidence layer for MCP. Find, verify, then connect directly to the server.
